title: Ahead of The Beatles’ New Biopic, Beatlemania Is Back With T-Shirts, Mugs, Books & More Merch
summary: Show your love and pride for the Fab Four with new merch and apparel.
contentText:

It’s hard to talk about the Beatles’ upcoming big-screen return without wanting to revisit the music , the albums and, of course, the merch. Sam Mendes’ highly anticipated four-part Beatles biopic, The Beatles – A Four-Film Cinematic Event , is currently filming ahead of its planned April 2028 theatrical release. The films will each focus on a different member of the legendary band, with Paul Mescal as Paul McCartney, Harris Dickinson as John Lennon, Joseph Quinn as George Harrison and Barry Keoghan as Ringo Starr.

Fans have already gotten a glimpse of the production, with the cast spotted filming in London and recreating the Beatles’ famous walk across the Abbey Road zebra crossing . But you don’t have to wait until 2028 to celebrate the band.

Shop Beatles Merch & Apparel

From the Beatles’ album artwork to its instantly recognizable logo, the band’s imagery has become a fixture of pop culture, and there’s plenty of merch that puts it front and center. Amazon carries a wide selection of officially licensed Beatles merchandise, including T-shirts, sweatshirts, mugs, books, collectibles and home video releases. Fanatics also has a selection of Beatles apparel and fan gear.
